data.title: Wonder Garden Opens at Boulevard City as Part of Riyadh Season
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Wonder Garden opened today in the heart of Boulevard City as part of the seventh edition of Riyadh Season.
    On its opening day, the zone welcomed visitors accompanied by their families and friends, who explored its attractions and entertainment experiences in a lively atmosphere.
    Wonder Garden is an integrated entertainment destination that takes visitors on a journey through nature-inspired areas, featuring a variety of rides and entertainment experiences, alongside international shops, restaurants, and cafés.
    The zone features several entertainment areas, each with its own character. Flower Garden offers rides, entertainment experiences, restaurants, and cafés around a plaza decorated with flowers and sculptures. Night Garden provides a variety of dining options in an evening setting adorned with illuminated floral sculptures, while Mystery Forest, inspired by a woodland environment, offers a range of entertainment experiences.
    Wonder Garden returns this year with larger experiences and more diverse entertainment options, including Garden Street and Boulevard Nights, alongside the international interactive children's show "Rachel's World," which offers an entertainment experience designed for young audiences.
    The zone also features a selection of rides and entertainment experiences, including 2Extreme, which combines adventure and challenge; Flying Dumbo's, a children's ride aboard flying elephants; the Little Star dress-up experience; and the interactive A Lot Like Life experience.
    Tickets to Wonder Garden can be booked through the Webook platform, where visitors can explore booking options and available experiences.
    Wonder Garden returns as part of Riyadh Season following its success and popularity in previous editions, continuing to offer a wide range of rides and entertainment experiences suitable for visitors of all ages.
    -- SPA
